en: A round multi-view color postcard bordered in orange, featuring four photographic scenes of the city of Pécs. The upper-left shows a historic cathedral with multiple towers above a hillside of houses. The upper-right shows a central square with a domed former mosque and surrounding buildings, cars, and a large paved plaza. The lower-left image shows a modern, terraced hotel or public building. The lower-right shows a broader cityscape with modern high‑rise blocks set against green hills. In the center front is a white label with bold black text reading "PÉCS". The reverse side has standard postcard layout printed in Hungarian, with areas for stamp, address lines, and price information.
